workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI validation proof-out adapter IAU candidate

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority can shape validation readback facts and pure validation proof artifacts, but it has no public import, Spec Kit feature, admission record, or clean-room adapter that binds vihs --validate --proof-out <dir> to deterministic file artifacts.

splitDecision.reason: Proof-out file adaptation is smaller than runtime validation execution and can be tested from supplied validation/proof facts without starting LabVIEWCLI, Docker, compare execution, live terminal proof, packaging, Marketplace, or launcher/profile mutation.

allowed: prerequisite references to the already implemented terminal entrypoint, prompt-loop, terminal I/O adapter, validation readback, and validation proof-artifact slices
package identity vi-history / VI History / svelderrainruiz / MIT / 0.1.0
proof-out target facts that identify a supplied public-safe output directory without exposing private host paths
public-safe proof JSON and issue-body emission from supplied validation proof facts
fail-closed reasons for missing validation facts, missing proof facts, unsupported proof-out target shape, and unavailable artifact content
blocked: private evidence roots or local filesystem paths
credentials, token names, or release credentials
source-copying instructions from another VI History authority
private proof packets or private issue templates
live already-running VS Code session uptake proof or live terminal proof
package/bin publication, launcher/profile mutation, VSIX packaging, Marketplace publication, or release automation
